snippet.title: DUSTTALE: THE GENOCIDE'S END - ACT 2 GAMEPLAY TEASER (Last Genocide HARDMODE)
snippet.description:
A gameplay teaser for DTGE ACT 2! In this battle you are playing as Sans, using bone attacks and Gaster Blasters against Undyne, who is willing to put an end to this madness...

DUSTTALE: THE GENOCIDE'S END is the sequel to DustTale: Last Genocide, and it no longer follows a last breath format, instead being a more in-depth DustTale hardmode take with it's own twists.

Keep in mind that nothing here is final and is a subject to change.
Please, do NOT use/reupload assets or footage from this video without team's permission. 

Game page:
https://gamejolt.com/games/dusttale-last-genocide/513360

DTLG/DTGE Discord server:
https://discord.gg/dtlg-official-server

DTLG/DTGE Official SoundCloud page:
https://m.soundcloud.com/dtlg-offical

Video/audio editing, thumbnail and game programming by MaxHardcore (Me)
Sprite assets by Eligos and Sotwound
Battle music by Vesperr
